build_select_from_model: build feature selection using SelectFromModel with RidgeCV coefficients and a threshold to pick top features
build_sequential_feature_selector: build forward and backward sequential feature selection using SequentialFeatureSelector with a specified estimator
build_load_diabetes_dataset: build a pipeline that loads the diabetes dataset and computes feature importances from RidgeCV coefficients
build_sequential_backward_selection: build backward sequential feature selection with SequentialFeatureSelector using negative tolerance values on breast cancer data
build_feature_importance_plot: build a bar chart of feature importances from RidgeCV coefficients using matplotlib on the diabetes dataset
